stdout:
Delete playlists. Use this tool to delete playlists by IDs.

Usage:
  yutu playlist delete [flags]

Examples:
# Delete a playlist by ID
yutu playlist delete --ids PLxxxx
# Delete multiple playlists
yutu playlist delete --ids PLxxx1,PLxxx2

Flags:
  -h, --help                            help for delete
  -i, --ids strings                     IDs of the playlists to delete
  -b, --onBehalfOfContentOwner string   ID of the content owner, for YouTube content partners
      --yes                             Confirm the operation
